additional_info.subject: ID042563-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / R7 170002231]- Salo FC14 tripped second time CRM:02888000003
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus, good afternoon.
As we already aligned, please check on the 24V line, where the trip is occurring.
My suggestion is to start with the HMI which is the most problematic device, I already faced this issue many times.
Please start up the charger without the 24V line to the HMI and test plugging in the 24V when it's started. If we get a trip, just record everything for evidence and replace the HMI.
If it's not the HMI, we need to search for the line that is causing this. Test each and every circuit one by one until we have a culprit.
Let me know if you need any support. I will send this ticket back to you.
Best regards,
Francisco
